BiblicalUsage: Shehariah appears once, in a list of Benjamites: Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah, in the sons of Jeroham. No profile of his own survives, and the verse gives no more than the name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in a list is still a person God counted. Shehariah is named among his brothers, and I hold that being counted is enough.
